name: Runes
overview: Scripture uses the imagery of running to illustrate the believer's journey of obedience and perseverance in the faith. Psalms 119:32 expresses a heart enlarged by God's commandments that enables one to 'run the way' He sets. Isaiah 40:31 promises renewed strength for those who wait on the Lord, enabling them to run without weariness. The New Testament echoes this in Galatians 5:7, urging believers to continue running well by obeying the truth, and in Hebrews 12:1, which exhorts laying aside sin to run patiently the race set before us. Together, these verses portray the Christian life as a disciplined, empowered race sustained by faith and endurance.
